name: pcc-react
description: React source for PCC's progressive React migration (Post-Phase-5 Engineering Evolution, priority 1). Compiled by esbuild into src/js/vendor/react-bundle.js, an IIFE with React+ReactDOM bundled directly in (no CDN, no runtime npm dependency) — build.js then inlines it into index.html exactly like every other vendored library. This directory's own node_modules and esbuild step are dev/packaging-time only: the shipped Electron/Capacitor/file:// index.html never needs Node, npm, or this directory present.
